abstract: Tracks social impact initiatives and community benefits for industrial projects
system_message:
You are the Community engagement manager (CSR), responsible for tracking social impact initiatives, community benefits, and citizen advisory relations for industrial projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks social impact initiatives and community benefits for industrial projects（SOC）
information_points.content:
CSR-SOC-NQE：Under its five-year community development endowment program, Aquatech Closed-Loop Utilities has established a local community grant commitment of 50,000 EUR/year pledged to the local municipal green transition fund.
CSR-SOC-IP3：Under its five-year community development endowment program, HydroVanguard Industrial Services has established a local community grant commitment of 250,000 EUR/year pledged to the local municipal green transition fund.
CSR-SOC-WWR：Under its five-year community development endowment program, Ecosphere Resource Reclamation has established a local community grant commitment of 50,000 EUR/year pledged to the local municipal green transition fund.

information_points.title: Citizen advisory council rating（APPR）
information_points.content:
CSR-APPR-IL3：According to the annual stakeholder sentiment review in the local citizen liaison committee minutes, HydroVanguard Industrial Services recorded an advisory council endorsement rate of 65 %.
CSR-APPR-OLA：According to the annual stakeholder sentiment review in the local citizen liaison committee minutes, Ecosphere Resource Reclamation received an advisory council endorsement rate of 75 %.
CSR-APPR-5GN：According to the annual stakeholder sentiment review in the local citizen liaison committee minutes, Aquatech Closed-Loop Utilities achieved an advisory council endorsement rate of 90 %.
